item.title: Dharma MahaSammelan 2025 at Babanagar, Jamalpur Inspires Devotion, Unity, and Spiritual Awakening - Ananda Marga
item.description: The three-day Dharma MahaSammelan 2025 at Babanagar, Jamalpur (24–26 October) was a grand spiritual gathering filled with Dharma Cakra, Prabhát Saḿgiita, Akhaṇḍ Kiirtan, RAWA performances, competitions, marriages, and inspiring discourses by Revered P.P. Ác. Vishvadevánanda Avadhúta, uniting Margiis from across India and abroad.

item.title: Dharma MahaSammelan (DMS) Malaysia 2025 Concludes with Global Spiritual Vibrance at Berjaya Hills - Ananda Marga

Vishvadevánanda Avadhúta.

item.title: Winter Humanitarian Service Initiatives by Ananda Marga Pracaraka Samgha, Bengaluru Bhukti - Ananda Marga

item.title: 🌍 Renaissance Universal(RU) Celebration – A Call for Universal Awakening 🌍 - Ananda Marga
item.description: Renaissance Universal Day was celebrated at historic Trimuhan, Bhagalpur, marking the first RU discourse by Shrii Shrii Anandamurti ji (25 Jan 1958), with a seminar on “The Challenges of Human Life Amidst Today’s Global Crisis.”The program inspired universal awakening through Neo-Humanism, emphasizing unity beyond caste, creed, and division.
